annotations.title: How to pay for a listing

description: How a listing is paid for, step by step, and what it costs: per payment type (free, x402, mpp, ap2, acp, l402, api_key, subscription, unknown) ordered steps and the cost (amount, asset, network, USD for recognised stablecoins); with `payer` (an object, {"networks": ["eip155:8453"], "assets": ["0x..."]}, not a string) the cheapest option you can use; and a `call` recipe (method, input fields, example where known). Steps the board cannot state are marked documented: false. Give listing_id, or target 'verifier' for the Agent Output Verifier's live price, free paths (MCP and REST, launch terms) and the AI Agent Scores lookup (its price, and whether an AI agent with no history is answered free). It only explains; it never pays. Deterministic. Free, no payment or account required.

Payer.description: What the caller can pay with: an OBJECT with two lists, not a string.

assets.description: Token contract addresses (or Solana mints) you can pay with, e.g. USDC's - a list, even for one asset.

networks.description: CAIP-2 chain ids your wallet can pay on, e.g. ['eip155:8453'] (Base) - a list, even for one chain.

agent_id.description: Optional label for yourself (usage statistics only).

listing_id.description: A listing id (UUID). Give this or target.

payer.description: Optional. What you can pay with, used to pick the cheapest option you can use. An OBJECT, not a string: {"networks": ["eip155:8453"], "assets": ["0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913"]}. Leave it out to see every option.

target.description: 'verifier': the Agent Output Verifier's own price and free path.

trace_id.description: trace_id from a previous response, to continue a conversation; omit on the first call.
